verdict.rationale: Kick advertises a CLI and MCP integration for automating workflows ("Connect MCP or CLI to take it further... automate month-end checks, and build workflows that run across every workspace"), and rules run automatically on sync, suggesting some headless automation capability. However, there is no CLI documentation, no CI setup guide, no scripting examples, and an openapi probe found no public API surface. missing for 10: dedicated CLI docs/reference, CI integration guide, headless auth/config examples, and independent confirmation of automated/CI usage.
